systems.system: eGabon-SIS (Système d'Information de Santé, second phase)
systems.owner: Government of Gabon (ministries of Digital Economy and Health, ANINF), with World Bank technical and financial support
systems.tiers: 13 pilot public health structures across the country received a first lot of computer equipment on 28 July 2025; tier not stated

note: Reports the handover of computer equipment to 13 pilot health structures on 28 July 2025 at the launch of the second phase of the SIS; it speaks only of collecting, processing and securing medical data and interconnecting establishments, without saying whether the system is aggregate reporting or a patient record, so it is unclassified and no fact is taken.
